{{Quote|I am Heart Rend. The dark ones are my treasure. Their torrent of fear will shatter our tomb.|Heart Rend|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Heart Rend''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] who lived during the height of his species reign thousands of years ago. During this time, his race had acquired the wrath of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] due to their marauding of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] slave worlds. This led to the Rakata imprisoning the Esh-kha along with Heart Rend on the prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] where they were kept conscious but immobile in [[Prison|stasis]] for millennia. He was accidentally freed from the Belsavis vaults during an attack by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prison facility. Upon being freed, Heart Rend led his warriors where they discovered the captive [[Dread Masters]] whereupon he decided to use these [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] incredible fear related [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers to break through their imprisonment.

Thus, he empowered his own High Savants with the stolen energies of the Dread Masters and employed them against their enemies whilst they sought a means of breaking forth from the prison vaults. However, Heart Rend attracted the attention of a Sith representative who had been sent on a mission to free the Dread Masters. He was defeated and was unable to prevent the Dread Masters from being freed. The combined Dread Masters killed Heart Rend by overwhelming his mind with fear.
